subject: POC trial: model selection & success criteria - FinLytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial: model selection & success criteria - FinLytics

Thanks again for the time today, Laura — great conversation.

Recap + proposed POC plan based on what we discussed:

1) Objective (what success looks like)
- Improve the accuracy of automated transaction classification to >= 92% on FinLytics' label set (primary success metric).
- Latency SLO: median inference latency <= 220ms per request for single-record classification (95th < 500ms) during trial traffic profile.
- Multilingual coverage: parity (within ~3%) on Spanish and French test slices compared to English baseline.
- Integration: deliver a validated endpoint + test harness so your engineering team can run integration tests.

2) Suggested evaluation plan (3-week lightweight POC)
- Week 1: Data ingestion & baseline run — FinLytics provides ~5k representative labeled samples (include Spanish/French slices). Redwood will run a baseline with current in-house model and document metrics.
- Week 2: Model evaluation — test 2 candidate models on the dataset (see model_comparison.xlsx). We'll measure accuracy, latency, and token cost.
- Week 3: Integration and handoff — endpoint, docs, and a short runbook for production rollout.

3) Model recommendations for the trial
- Primary: Llama-2-13b-chat (quantized FP16) — best balance of multilingual capability and quality for classification prompts.
- Fallback/Cost-optimized: Mistral-7B-Instruct (8-bit quant) — lower latency/cost for lower-compute paths and tail routing.
- Notes: if we see failure modes for certain finance-specific tokens, we'll test a small instruction-tuning step during week 2.

4) Ownership & resources
- Redwood tech lead: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.com) — will provision the trial endpoint and support data onboarding.
- Redwood infra/cost lead: Aditya Rao (aditya.rao@redwood.com) — will monitor pricing and propose batching/quantization configs.
- FinLytics lead: Laura Chen — will own providing the labeled dataset and coordinating internal test sign-offs.

5) Deliverables
- POC success criteria doc (attached).
- Model comparison spreadsheet with perf/cost estimates (we'll attach after initial runs).
- Trial endpoint + test harness + runbook.

Next steps (action items):
- Laura: share the 5k labeled samples (include Spanish/French distribution) by EOD Wed (2026-08-12).
- Dev (Redwood): provision trial endpoint and share credentials by Thu morning (2026-08-13).
- Aditya (Redwood): initial perf/cost estimate and recommended default config by Thu (2026-08-13).

Attachments: POC_success_criteria.docx (outline + pass/fail gates).

If that lines up with your expectations, I'll open the trial and we can lock dates.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finlytics.com>

Cc: FinLytics SalesOps <salesops@finlytics.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial: model selection & success criteria - FinLytics

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and thorough. Couple quick clarifications before we push the data: 

- For the 5k samples, is there a minimum per-language threshold you need for Spanish/French to get statistically meaningful results?
- Can you confirm whether the trial endpoints will be in us-west region (we need data residency in US only)?
- What SLA do you have in the trial (uptime/response time) and will we be able to measure token-level cost in the dashboard?

Also, to set expectations internally: our security/compliance team will want to see the SOC 2 attestation and info on logs retention for the trial. Is that something you can attach?

If all good, I'll aim to send the dataset by Wednesday EOD.

Best,
Laura
Head of Data Science, FinLytics
laura.chen@finlytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial: model selection & success criteria - FinLytics

Thanks Laura — quick answers inline: 

- Minimum per-language: aim for ~500 labeled examples per language (so ~500 Spanish, ~500 French) to get a reasonable signal for relative performance; the rest can be English. We'll surface confidence intervals in the week-2 report.
- Region: yes, trial endpoints will be provisioned in us-west by default for this engagement; we'll note residency in the runbook and logs.
- SLA for trial: we provide best-effort uptime for POC endpoints; we'll instrument monitoring and share charts. If you need a formal SLA during the trial, we can discuss a short-term Dedicated slot (Aditya to advise on cost).
- Cost visibility: yes — we'll provide token-level breakdowns in the Redwood Console and exportable CSVs.
- Compliance docs: attaching SOC2_summary.pdf and our trial retention policy (we keep logs for 30 days unless you request otherwise).

Updated timeline & owners (confirming):
- Wed 8/12 EOD: FinLytics provides dataset (Laura).
- Thu 8/13 AM: Dev provisions trial endpoint + creds (Dev).
- Thu 8/13 EOD: Redwood baseline results + model_comparison.xlsx (Marissa/Aditya).
- Fri 8/14: Quick sync (30m) to review results and decide next steps.

Attached: POC_success_criteria.docx, SOC2_summary.pdf (inline), model_comparison.xlsx (will be populated).

Let us know if the schedule works and we'll lock the provisioning.

Cheers,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial: model selection & success criteria - FinLytics

Looping in quick infra notes from my side: 

- Provisioning: I'll allocate a dedicated trial slot in us-west and share credentials by EOD Thu (2026-08-13) morning at the latest.
- Cost/perf knobs we'll enable for the POC: 1) 8-bit quant where possible for Mistral fallback, 2) default batch size=8 for classification tests, 3) KV cache enabled for multi-turn scenarios (not needed for plain single-record classification but helpful if you test conversation flows).
- Token limits: suggest a 2048 token cap for the trial to cover variable-length inputs.
- Fallback routing: configure policy to route to Mistral-7B for lower-cost requests and Llama-2-13b-chat for higher-accuracy classification; we'll surface per-route cost in the console.
- Compliance artifacts: attaching SOC2_summary.pdf (shared by Marissa). For trial logs we retain 30 days by default; we can extend on request.

Action: I'll post the endpoint URL, API key, and a short runbook to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-folder-id) once ready.

Thanks — looking forward to the dataset.

Aditya Rao
Infra & Cost, Redwood Inference
